summary: Deep testing of backend hardening changes (A01-A06) completed successfully. All original invariants now pass. Updated test_audit_regressions.py removing strict xfails for A01-A05. Rewrote A06 test to reflect architectural change: extraction now ONLY stages proposal via completion lease CAS with NO academic destination writes. Added 9 deep concurrent test cases covering retry aliases, conflicting intents, stale revisions, archive recovery, job dispatch, auth, and publication outbox crash scenarios. All 21 audit regression tests pass. Verified dependency upgrades: Motor 3.7.1, PyMongo 4.18.3, PyJWT 2.15.1, Pillow 12.3.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-asyncio 1.4.0. Full packet1 suite: 198 tests passed.

a06_safe_extraction.verification: Extraction completes with proposal in job doc, zero destination writes to sets collection, academic content unchanged
a06_safe_extraction.architectural_note: Original regression (stale lease writing to destination) eliminated by removing direct destination path. Extraction now ONLY stages proposal, never mutates academic content. Unified importer is supported publication path.
